name: ZKasino
rootCause: The house always wins and ZKasino hit the jackpot, making off with a $33 million rug over the weekend.

descriptions.text: The house always wins and ZKasino hit the jackpot, making off with a $33 million rug over the weekend.

The decentralized betting platform ZKasino is suspected to have exited. Recently, users on Twitter reported that ZKasino removed the message "Ethereum will be returned and can be bridged back" from the Bridge Funds interface, causing users to be unable to withdraw. Subsequently, the project team transferred the ETH assets deposited by users to the 0x791 multi-signature address, and then deposited them into the staking protocol Lido for yield farming.
